summary: Carl meets Mordecai, who becomes the party's registered guide.
Imani becomes known as a capable allied crawler from Meadow Lark.
Elle becomes known as a surviving Meadow Lark crawler.
Li Na becomes known through the surviving crawler network.
Mordecai becomes Donut's manager and permanent support specialist.
Katia temporarily joins Donut's party to train and share experience.
Prepotente becomes known as a powerful independent crawler allied with Miriam Dom.
Katia is accepted as a permanent member of Carl and Donut's core team.
Louis becomes known as an allied crawler and vehicle specialist.
Samantha becomes known to the group as a dangerous but recurring companion.
Katia leaves the formal party while remaining a close ally and team leader.
Imani becomes guildmaster of the broader allied crawler network.
